title: Cops Find Severed Head at New Mexico Park
description:
Bodycam footage shows New Mexico police responding to a 911 call after people in a park reported finding a dead body. Police took Joel Arciniega-Saenz into custody after he was identified as a suspect before he revealed details of the crime. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
